title: The Rose Code
author: Kate Quinn
summary: Three women from very different backgrounds work as codebreakers at Bletchley Park during the Second World War. In 1947 a cryptic message pulls the friends, now divided by betrayal, back together.
readIf: you like historical novels about women's wartime work, with friendship and a code to crack.
skipIf: you want deep technical detail on cryptography or a short, fast read.
